body.name: \(\mathsf X_{\eta,\theta}\)
body.def: Given \(\mathscr S_\eta\), draw \((g,Z)\sim N(0,\Sigma_\eta)\); observe the pre coordinate \(h+H_L^{-1}g\) in any fixed coordinates on \(L\) and, for every shared-noise knot group, the coordinates \(d_i+Z_g\), where \(d_i-d_k\) within a cell is fixed by \(\eta\) and \(\theta\) supplies only the unresolved group translations and finite face offsets.
